ret: 1 training day (A) holding 2 exercises, over block weeks train ×4, once.
Block weeks: train, train, train, train, once. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed. Loads on a 2.5 kg grid.
Rotation: Each training week: Day A, then Day A.
Attendance (from the rotation): Train at least 2 times in each 7-day window (from your start day). If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.
Day A: superset bench and pass: rest 0 s between them, then 120 s.
bench: 4 sets of Barbell Bench Press in the phase rep range, starting at the benchStart handed on by the previous phase; add 2.5 kg once every set reaches the top of the range.
pass: 4 sets of 10 reps of Medicine Ball Chest Pass, unloaded, as explosively as possible.

ret.start: the benchStart handed on by the previous phase
